title: Eliciting Trustworthiness Priors of Large Language Models via Economic Games

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating the Trust Game using iterated in-context learning to elicit the model's trustworthiness priors, and measuring how the return ratio changes when the trustor is assigned different personas (e.g., occupational roles like 'doctor' or 'AI', and public figures). The variations are evaluated against a stereotype-based model grounded in perceived warmth and competence.
